summary: Yatsen Holding Ltd files a Form 6-K (May 2026) reporting its Q1 2026 financial results. The document is a routine earnings release, not a special situation. It announces unaudited results with highlights on revenue growth, gross margin expansion, and a net loss. The CEO mentions the first closing of a private placement of convertible notes and warrants for ~US$120 million, but this is a capital-raising event, not a transformative special situation like a going-private or tender offer. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation event. It is categorized as a routine financial report with no special-situation implications.
